method: Authenticated GSC UI, Indexing > Pages report, drilled into each reason bucket, filtered by URL substring (/compare/, /software/, /best-)

bucketA_neverActuallyCrawled.evidenceForLabel: All sampled rows show last-crawled = 'לא זמין' (not available) -- Google has discovered these URLs but never actually crawled them. This is DISCOVERED_NOT_INDEXED, not CRAWLED_NOT_INDEXED, despite the Hebrew UI phrase containing the word for 'crawled'.

comparison.samplingNote: Sample truncated by tool output limits; not exhaustive but a large, real, live-sourced sample.

bucketB_trulyCrawledNotIndexed.evidenceForLabel: Sampled rows show real recent last-crawled dates (e.g. 2026-08-23 through 2026-08-25 in one filtered view, 2026-09-19 through 2026-09-20 in the unfiltered view) -- Google DID crawl these and chose not to index them. This is the true CRAWLED_NOT_INDEXED bucket, and the one Waves 1-3's content-depth treatment actually targets correctly.
bucketB_trulyCrawledNotIndexed.activeFixValidation: GSC shows 'אימות התיקון: התחיל 24.9.2026' (Fix validation: started 2026-09-24) on this exact reason bucket -- someone (unclear who, in this shared multi-agent environment) already clicked 'Validate Fix' 2 days before this snapshot. Recorded as an observed fact; not investigated further this session.

comparison.samplingNote: Sample truncated by tool output limits; not exhaustive.

software.samplingNote: Count confirmed live; URL-level list not cleanly captured this session due to a read_page caching bug (accumulated stale content across filter changes). Not blocking -- Waves 1-3 already independently confirmed 62 software URLs individually via URL Inspection; this 175 figure is additional context, not a new candidate list Wave 4 must fully enumerate before acting.

criticalCorrection: The prior missions' baseline framing ('1,645/1,923 crawled-not-indexed') collapsed two structurally different problems into one number. As of this snapshot: 820 URLs are DISCOVERED_NOT_INDEXED (Google knows about them but has never crawled them -- an internal-linking/crawl-budget/sitemap-priority problem) and 825 URLs are truly CRAWLED_NOT_INDEXED (Google crawled them and excluded them from the index -- a content-quality/duplication problem, which is what Waves 1-3's factual-depth treatment correctly targets). These need different interventions and should not be conflated going forward.
toolLimitation: get_page_text and ref_id-scoped read_page calls returned stale cached DOM snapshots repeatedly during this session (a known issue with this GSC UI). Fresh full-page read_page calls (no ref_id) immediately after a filter change were reliable for smaller lists (<200 rows) but truncated for larger ones (600+ rows) due to output size limits. CSV/Sheets/Excel export triggers a real file download the browser tool cannot capture as a response body. All URL lists in this file are real, live-sourced, and unmodified -- no URL was fabricated -- but the comparison lists in both buckets are large-sample, not exhaustive enumerations.
